You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:prescription_error: Prescriptions and e-prescribing problems always go to a human. (also matched: suspected_outage) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Medication substitution system crashing continuously

We are having a terrible morning here because the prescription refill and medication substitution system keeps crashing across all of our workstations. Every time our providers try to respond to a pharmacy out-of-stock notification, the system kicks them out entirely. We cannot send any alternative medications to pharmacies right now. Please fix this quickly so we can get back to work.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for bringing this issue to our attention. I’m sorry to hear that the prescription refill and medication substitution system is crashing for your providers. A member of our support team is now reviewing the situation and will work to resolve it as quickly as possible.

We appreciate your patience while we investigate the cause of the crashes. If you have any additional details or notice any patterns that might help us, please feel free to share them.

Thank you,
[Support Team]"
}
